description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'word_pos_logreg' baseline: word+POS combined featurizer (English) + Logistic Regression.
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'word_pos_logreg', group(s): linguistic); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
